site.subtitle: Our own NikkiNind weaves — plus curated handloom from partner brands. One craft. Many makers. Each piece on its own page.

designs.title: Moonloom Stripe
designs.summary: House-line cloud-soft cotton with graphite stripes that catch morning light.
designs.detail: Woven on a pit loom in dense cotton. Washed six times for that lived-in drape — still crisp enough to hold a fold.
designs.origin: NikkiNind house weave from Karur. Graphite warp, mist weft, matcha selvedge stitch.

designs.title: Saffron Mist
designs.summary: Partner brand Aaranya Loom — warm saffron warp meets mist-grey weft.
designs.detail: A limited handloom run with floating selvedge and tonal embroidery along the cuff.
designs.origin: Curated for NikkiNind. Handwoven in small batches with plant-dyed saffron yarn.

designs.title: Ink Garden
designs.summary: House botanical motifs on charcoal handloom cotton — gallery quiet, bed soft.
designs.detail: Natural dyes and hand-blocked motifs on a slightly irregular handloom weave that photographs like art.
designs.origin: NikkiNind house weave — woven first, then block-printed by hand.

designs.title: River Check
designs.summary: Partner brand Khadi North — oversized checks in river blue and foam.
designs.detail: Lightweight handloom khadi with a brushed face. Designed to look intentional on a messy bed.
designs.origin: Curated partner weave. Spun and woven by hand — soft check that still reads sharp on camera.

designs.title: Petal Grid
designs.summary: Partner brand Softloom Co. — blush petal micro-grid on bone cotton.
designs.detail: Percale handfeel from a dense handloom sett. Matte finish, soft hand, clean lines.
designs.origin: Curated for NikkiNind. Bone cotton warp with blush petal weft accents.

designs.title: Loom Noir
designs.summary: House near-black handloom with a satin-sheen stripe that only shows when you move.
designs.detail: For the moody bedroom. Dense handloom weave, cool touch, maximal drama with zero clutter.
designs.origin: NikkiNind house weave. Near-black yarn hand-picked for depth.

updates.title: Studio notes: why we wash house sheets six times
updates.body: New handloom can feel stiff. NikkiNind house sheets are washed, dried, and pressed in a slow cycle before they hit a shoot — so the first night already feels like night forty. Partner brands keep their own craft notes on each product page.

updates.title: Opening the floor to partner handloom brands
updates.body: NikkiNind is a handloom house — we sell our own weaves and carefully curated pieces from makers like Aaranya Loom, Khadi North, and Softloom Co. Same craft standard. Clear maker credit on every page.

updates.title: Every weave gets a page — house or partner
updates.body: Whether it’s a NikkiNind house drop or a partner brand, each handloom piece lives on its own scroll story: look, craft, loom, maker, palette.
